idea-plugin.name: Python Web Code Generator
idea-plugin.description:
Python Web Code Generator

Generate CRUD code for multiple Python web frameworks from database schemas or existing Python models.

Supported Frameworks

  • FastAPI - Modern async framework with automatic OpenAPI docs
  • Flask - Lightweight and flexible microframework
  • Django REST Framework - Powerful toolkit for building Web APIs
  • Sanic - Async-first framework for high performance
  • Starlette - Lightweight ASGI framework

Supported ORMs

  • SQLAlchemy
  • SQLModel
  • Tortoise ORM
  • Peewee
  • Django ORM
  • Piccolo

Features

  • Auto-detect project framework, ORM, and response patterns
  • Generate models, schemas, services, and routers
  • Sync database schema from models (CREATE/ALTER TABLE)
  • Support MySQL and PostgreSQL
  • Works with both PyCharm Community and Professional
